## Packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(cowplot)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(performance)

source(here::here("scripts", "R", "functions.R"))
dir.create("figures/benchmarking", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999)
set.seed(5)
```

## Data

```{r load data}
experiment_order <- c("hg_mgx", "hg_mtx", "htx_mgx", "htx_mtx")

df <- read_csv("data/benchmarking/benchmark_all_results_with_network_stats.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(experiment_type = factor(experiment_type, levels = experiment_order),
         across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(., 0)),
         source = case_when(source == "DM"        ~ "DM (dmh + all foods)",
                            source == "DM (FFQ)"  ~ "DM (dmh + FFQ)",
                            source == "IBD"       ~ "IBD (dmh + all foods)",
                            source == "ZIM"       ~ "ZIM (dm + FFQ)",
                            source == "ZIM (dmh)" ~ "ZIM (dmh + FFQ)"))

df %>%
  group_by(source, food_representation) %>%
  summarise(host_kos = sum(n_ko_host), .groups = "drop")
```

## Tables

```{r general stats table, fig.width=10}
metric_labels <- c(
  n              = "n",
  runtime_sec    = "Runtime (s)",
  peak_memory_mb = "Peak memory (MB)",
  n_reactions    = "Reactions (n)",
  n_nodes        = "Network nodes (n)",
  n_edges        = "Network edges (n)",
  shannon        = "Shannon diversity",
  n_taxa         = "Taxa observed (n)",
  n_ko           = "Microbial KOs (n)",
  n_ko_host      = "Host KOs (n)"
)

summary_long <- df %>%
  select(source, runtime_sec, peak_memory_mb, n_reactions, n_nodes, n_edges,
         shannon, n_taxa, n_ko, n_ko_host) %>%
  pivot_longer(-source, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(source, metric) %>%
  summarise(mean_sd = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), sd(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = mean_sd)

n_row <- df %>%
  count(source, name = "n") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = n) %>%
  mutate(metric = "n", across(-metric, as.character)) %>%
  relocate(metric)

table_gen_stats <- bind_rows(n_row, summary_long) %>%
  mutate(metric = recode(metric, !!!metric_labels)) %>%
  arrange(match(metric, metric_labels)) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "metric") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Per sample benchmarking by study") %>%
  cols_width(stub() ~ px(150), everything() ~ px(170)) %>%
  tab_source_note("Values are mean ± SD across all participants.")

table_gen_stats
# gtsave(table_gen_stats, "figures/benchmarking/table_b_gen_stats.png")
```

## Resource-use models

```{r models}
model_df <- df %>%
  select(participant_id, source, runtime_sec, peak_memory_mb, n_ko, n_taxa, shannon) %>%
  mutate(study = if_else(str_starts(source, "DM"), "DM", "ZIM"),
         host  = if_else(source == "ZIM (dm + FFQ)", "no", "yes"),
         diet  = if_else(source == "DM (dmh + all foods)", "all foods", "FFQ"))

memory_model_df <- model_df %>%
  filter(host == "yes") %>%
  mutate(n_ko_k = n_ko / 1000)

# Shannon vs number of taxa as the diversity term
mem  <- fit_diversity_pair("peak_memory_mb", model_df,        c("study", "host", "diet"))
run  <- fit_diversity_pair("runtime_sec",    model_df,        c("study", "host", "diet"))
mem2 <- fit_diversity_pair("peak_memory_mb", memory_model_df, c("study", "diet"))

compare_performance(mem$shan,  mem$taxa,  metrics = c("AIC", "BIC", "R2", "RMSE"))
compare_performance(run$shan,  run$taxa,  metrics = c("AIC", "BIC", "R2", "RMSE"))
compare_performance(mem2$shan, mem2$taxa, metrics = c("AIC", "BIC", "R2", "RMSE"))

# full models
m_runtime <- lmer(runtime_sec ~ n_taxa + n_ko + study + host + diet + (1 | participant_id),
                  data = model_df)
m_memory  <- lmer(peak_memory_mb ~ n_taxa + n_ko + study + diet + (1 | participant_id),
                  data = memory_model_df)
summary(m_runtime)
summary(m_memory)

# full vs reduced (likelihood-ratio tests)
m_mem_full <- lmer(peak_memory_mb ~ n_ko_k + n_taxa + study + diet + (1 | participant_id),
                   data = memory_model_df, REML = FALSE)
m_mem_red  <- lmer(peak_memory_mb ~ n_ko_k + (1 | participant_id),
                   data = memory_model_df, REML = FALSE)
anova(m_mem_red, m_mem_full)

m_run_full <- lmer(runtime_sec ~ n_ko + n_taxa + study + host + diet + (1 | participant_id),
                   data = model_df, REML = FALSE)
m_run_red  <- lmer(runtime_sec ~ host + diet + (1 | participant_id),
                   data = model_df, REML = FALSE)
anova(m_run_red, m_run_full)

# final estimates (REML)
m_mem_final <- update(m_mem_red, REML = TRUE)
m_run_final <- update(m_run_red, REML = TRUE)

confint(m_mem_final, method = "Wald")
confint(m_run_final, method = "Wald")
icc(m_mem_final)
icc(m_run_final)
confint(m_mem_final, method = "profile")
confint(m_run_final, method = "profile")

# memory cost of host data, KOs centred at 3,000
model_df <- model_df %>% mutate(n_ko_c = n_ko / 1000 - 3)
m_mem_host <- lmer(peak_memory_mb ~ n_ko_c + host + (1 | participant_id), data = model_df)
confint(m_mem_host, method = "profile")
```

## Figures

```{r figures, fig.width=10}
c_runtime <- source_boxplot(df, "runtime_sec",    "Runtime (s)")
c_memory  <- source_boxplot(df, "peak_memory_mb", "Peak memory (MB)")

p_size <- df %>%
  transmute(source, origin = "Microbe", count = na_if(n_ko, 0)) %>%
  source_boxplot("count", "KO Count") +
  facet_wrap(~ origin, scales = "free_y")

diversity_long <- df %>%
  select(source, shannon, n_taxa) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(shannon, n_taxa), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = recode(metric, shannon = "Shannon diversity", n_taxa = "Taxa observed"))

p_diversity <- source_boxplot(diversity_long, "value", "Value") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y")
p_legend <- source_boxplot(diversity_long, "value", "Value", legend = "bottom")

top_row    <- plot_grid(p_size, p_diversity, nrow = 1, labels = c("A", "B"), rel_widths = c(0.8, 1))
bottom_row <- plot_grid(c_runtime, c_memory, nrow = 1, labels = c("C", "D"), rel_widths = c(0.9, 1))

f_benchmarking <- plot_grid(top_row, bottom_row, get_legend(p_legend),
                            rel_heights = c(1, 1, 0.1), nrow = 3)
f_benchmarking

save_plot(filename = "figures/benchmarking/figure_b_benchmarking.png", f_benchmarking,
          base_width = 10, base_height = 7, bg = "white")
```
